# Nippon2Go

> Nippon2Go is a free Japan trip planner app for iPhone (iOS 17+) and Android, in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Korean and Traditional Chinese. It has 125+ hand-picked places in Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka, Nara, Kamakura, Yokohama and Hiroshima, works out how many days to spend in each city, builds day-by-day routes with walking and train times, and includes booking links, a pre-trip checklist and shared trips.

The guides below use the app's own data: its must-see days per city, its visit-time estimates and its train times and fares (usual timetable, one adult, one way, rounded).

## Guides (English)

- [Japan travel guides](https://nippon2go.com/guides/): What to see in Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka, Nara, Hiroshima, Kamakura and Yokohama, how many days to spend in each city, and 10 and 15-day itineraries.
- [10-Day Japan Itinerary: Tokyo, Kyoto and Osaka](https://nippon2go.com/guides/japan-10-days/): Japan in 10 days, day by day: 4 in Tokyo, 3 in Kyoto and 3 in Osaka, with what to see each day and the trains between cities with rough fares.
- [Japan 2-Week Itinerary (15 Days)](https://nippon2go.com/guides/japan-15-days/): Japan in 15 days (just over two weeks): Tokyo, Kyoto, Nara, Osaka and Hiroshima with Miyajima, what to see each day and the trains between cities.
- [Things to Do in Tokyo: Day-by-Day Must-Sees](https://nippon2go.com/guides/tokyo/): What to see in Tokyo by neighbourhood, how many days to spend and how to get around, with the Nippon2Go app's day-by-day route and Hakone and Fuji trips.
- [Things to Do in Kyoto: Day-by-Day Must-Sees](https://nippon2go.com/guides/kyoto/): What to see in Kyoto day by day: Fushimi Inari, Kiyomizu-dera, Arashiyama, the Golden Pavilion and Gion. How many days to spend and how to get there.
- [Things to Do in Osaka: Day-by-Day Must-Sees](https://nippon2go.com/guides/osaka/): What to see in Osaka: Dotonbori, the castle, Kuromon, Shinsekai, Kaiyukan aquarium and Universal Studios. How many days to spend and how to get there.
- [Nara in One Day: Deer, Tōdai-ji and Nara Park](https://nippon2go.com/guides/nara/): Nara in a day: the deer park, the Great Buddha of Tōdai-ji and the National Museum. How to get there from Kyoto or Osaka and what to see.
- [Hiroshima and Miyajima: a 2-Day Itinerary](https://nippon2go.com/guides/hiroshima/): Hiroshima and Miyajima in 2 days: Peace Park, the Atomic Bomb Dome, the museum, the great torii of Itsukushima and Mt Misen. With the Nippon2Go route.
- [Kamakura Day Trip: the Great Buddha and Temples](https://nippon2go.com/guides/kamakura/): Kamakura in a day from Tokyo: the Great Buddha, Hase-dera, Tsurugaoka Hachiman-gū, Komachi Street and the Enoden coast. What to see and how to get there.
- [Things to Do in Yokohama: Harbour and Chinatown](https://nippon2go.com/guides/yokohama/): What to see in Yokohama, half an hour from Tokyo: Minato Mirai, the Red Brick Warehouse, the Cup Noodles Museum, Chinatown and Sankei-en Garden.
